page.intro: Enter your baby’s birth details. We calculate the Janma Nakshatra and Pada, find the traditional naming syllable, and suggest names that begin with it.

form.title: Baby’s Details
form.preferredPlaceholder: Only if you already have a name in mind
form.approx: I am not sure the birth time is exact. We will show every Pada the Moon was in within an hour either side.

error.nameFormat: Please use English letters, spaces, hyphens or apostrophes (2 to 60 characters).
error.dobMissing: Please enter the baby's date of birth.
error.dobFuture: The date of birth cannot be in the future.
error.dobOld: Please enter a date from 1900 onwards.
error.tobMissing: Please enter the exact time of birth. The naming syllable depends on it.
error.placeMissing: Please choose the birthplace from the suggestions. Its coordinates and time zone are needed for the calculation.

card.verifyEditorial: Editorial pick: meaning to be confirmed

results.noMatch: We could not match {{nakshatra}}, Pada {{pada}} to a naming syllable, so no names are shown. Please try again or ask your family priest.
results.calculatedFrom: Calculated from the exact date, time and birthplace.
results.syllableBasis: {{nakshatra}}, Pada {{pada}}: names traditionally begin with the sound “{{syllable}}”.
results.uncertainTitle: The syllable may depend on the exact minute
results.nearBoundary: The Moon changes Pada within {{minutes}} minutes of this birth time, so a small difference in the recorded time could change the syllable.
results.approxSame: You said the birth time is approximate. Within {{minutes}} minutes either side, the Moon stays in the same Pada, so the syllable is the same across that window.
results.eachPada: The syllables for each Pada the Moon was in are:
results.confirmTime: Please confirm the birth time from the birth record or hospital certificate if you can.
results.fits: It begins with “{{syllable}}”, which matches the traditional syllable for this birth.
results.noFit: It does not begin with “{{syllable}}”, the traditional syllable for this birth. Many families still keep a cherished name and use the syllable for the formal naming (Namakarana) name.
results.spellingOnly: This checks the spelling only; a priest may judge by sound.
results.picksSub: Begin with “{{syllable}}”, have a checked meaning, and are short and easy to say.
results.picksTitle: Modern Picks for Your Little One
results.collectionSub: A curated list, not a generated one. Every name has its Devanagari spelling, a meaning, its origin and how it was checked.
results.noneForPreference: We do not yet have an established name beginning with “{{syllable}}” for this preference.
results.noneForFilters: No names match these filters or this search. Try “All” or clear the search.
results.otherTraditionNote: Some traditions give this syllable for the same Pada.

error.regUnreadable: We could not read that registration number.

error.preferred: Please enter a number from 1 to 9999, for example 0007.

page.calcError: We could not calculate your birth profile. Please check the details and try again.
page.imageAlt: Lucky Vehicle Number: a car and a registration plate under the stars
page.intro: Enter your birth details. We calculate your birth profile, Birth Number and Life Path, then read vehicle numbers against them with a method we show you step by step.

form.title: Your Details
form.vehicleTypeNote: Shown with your result. The traditional method is the same for every type of vehicle.
form.whatToDo: What would you like to do?
form.digitsNote: New numbers are always suggested as four-digit registration numbers. This choice applies to a registration you enter.

scope.number: The registration number only (last four digits)

compare.sub: Up to three numbers, side by side, all read with exactly the same rules.
compare.title: Compare Numbers
compare.addPlaceholder: Add a number, e.g. 0786 or MH 12 AB 0007
compare.empty: Add a number above, or press Compare on any suggested number.

results.profileSub: How a vehicle number is read, and the two numbers of yours it is read against.

steps.digitsNote: The evaluated digits, leading zeros kept
steps.reduceNote: Add again to one digit (11, 22, 33 stay)

results.notGuarantee: This is traditional numerology, not a guarantee of any outcome.
results.recSubFind: Everyday four-digit numbers, best matches first, each worked out with the same rule used to check an existing number.
results.recSubOther: Other everyday numbers you could explore, worked out with the same rule.
results.rangeNote: There are no everyday numbers in your preferred range, so we looked across all four-digit numbers instead.
results.recNone: We could not find a number to suggest for this profile.
results.leftOutTitle: Which numbers are left out, and why?
results.availability: These are numerology-based suggestions. Actual registration-number availability and allocation depend on your RTO.
results.savedNote: Saved in this browser only. They are not attached to your MyBhagya account.
results.disclaimer: Numerology is a traditional belief system and is not scientifically proven. A traditional reading of a number does not promise good or bad fortune for you or your vehicle, and it should never be a reason to worry about the number you have.

form.errBoth: Please choose both a start and an end date.

form.errLong: Please search at most 366 days at a time.
form.errPlace: Please choose the event location from the search results.
form.intro: Tell us where the event will take place and when you would like to search. No birth details are needed.
form.placeHelp: Search for the city, then pick it from the list. Sunrise, sunset and all timings are calculated for that place, not for where you are now.
form.datesNote: Dates are counted in the event location's time zone. You can search up to 366 days at a time.
form.weekdaysNote: Only weekdays this event's tradition already accepts can be returned.
form.todAny: Any time between sunrise and sunset
form.directionNote: If given, the weekday on which that direction is unfavourable (Dishashool) is left out.

page.imageAlt: A sun rising over a lotus and a calendar
page.intro: Explore suitable dates and timings for important events based on Hindu Panchang, calculated for your event location.
page.savedNote: Kept in this browser only. They are not attached to your account.

calendar.label: Calendar view
calendar.legendWindow: Suitable window (the gold part shows when, between sunrise and sunset)
calendar.legendMany: “2 windows”: more than one suitable window that day
calendar.legendFestival: a festival or observance (it does not make the date suitable or unsuitable)
calendar.legendNone: “none”: no qualifying window under this method
calendar.legendFaded: Faded: outside your search, not calculated
calendar.noWindowDate: No qualifying window on this date under the selected method.
calendar.select: Select a date to see its suitable timings.

results.confidenceConsensus: The core lists for this event (tithi, nakshatra, weekday) agree across the Panchang references consulted.
results.confidenceGeneral: This event follows the general auspicious-time conventions. The references consulted give no separate list for it, so no extra event-specific rule has been added.
results.copyFailedSelect: Could not copy. Please select the text and copy it.
results.shareCopied: Sharing is not available here, so the text was copied.
results.icsDone: Calendar file downloaded. Open it to add the event to your calendar.
results.icsFailed: Could not create the calendar file.
results.valuesAtStart: Values at the start of the window, {{time}} local time.
results.rankedAs: How this window was ranked ({{score}} of 100)
results.detailsFoot: All times are local time at the event location. The ranking only orders windows that already qualify; it is not a classical grade.
results.goldNote: Gold: every suitable window that day, between sunrise {{sunrise}} and sunset {{sunset}}
results.outsideAll: This window lies outside all three.
results.whyIntro: Each point below comes from the Panchang calculated for {{place}} on this date.
results.onOneDate: on 1 date, listed by date below
results.onDates: on {{count}} dates, listed by date below
results.notSuitableOne: 1 date with no suitable window, and why
results.notSuitableMany: {{count}} dates with no suitable window, and why

noResult.title: No suitable {{event}} found in these dates
noResult.body: We checked every date from {{start}} to {{end}} at {{place}}, interval by interval, using the Panchang calculated for that place. Nothing qualified under the selected method. This does not mean the event cannot be held; it means no time met every rule below.
noResult.datesChecked: Dates checked, and what ruled each one out
noResult.needsTitle: What would need to be different
noResult.needsNote: The event's traditional rules are not changed to produce a result. Another date, place or period is what can change the outcome.

share.localTime: local time at the event location
share.note1: Traditional Jyotish guidance for personal and cultural
share.note2: use. Not a prediction or a guarantee of any outcome.
share.icsDescription: {{range}} local time. {{paksha}} {{tithi}}, {{nakshatra}}. Traditional Jyotish guidance, not a guarantee. Confirm the final time with your priest or jyotishi.

Please share what troubles your heart — whether it is career, relationships, health, finances, or spiritual matters — and I will listen carefully.

You may speak or type in any language you are comfortable with. I will reply in the language chosen above.
